title: Sordland/Turn08/A_WomensRightsMeeting
description: A scene about the women's rights situation and passing laws to improve the conditions.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_PetrSelfResigned == true || BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_PetrForcedResign == true || BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_PetrTrialled == true)
entries.conditions: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_PetrSelfResigned"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_PetrForcedResign"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_PetrTrialled"] == true) == false

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was sitting in my office. I looke..."
entries.dialogueText: I was sitting in my office. I looked at the clock.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""It's a pity your wife won't be joi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a pity your wife won't be joining us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "2:26 PM. It was almost time for my..."
entries.dialogueText: 2:26 PM. It was almost time for my appointment with Ciara on women's rights.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a knock at the door. Ciar..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a knock at the door. Ciara entered the room with folders in her hand. The door did not close behind her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica entered the room and stood n..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica entered the room and stood next to Ciara.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica entered the room and stood n..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica entered the room and stood next to Ciara. I was confused. This was the opposite of what we had agreed after the Benfi Festival.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica turned to Ciara."
entries.dialogueText: Monica turned to Ciara.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Could you give us a minute?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Could you give us a minute?”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Of course.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right before she made her way out,..."
entries.dialogueText: Right before she made her way out, her eyes met with Monica's and the two women exchanged nods. The door closed, leaving Monica and me alone in the office.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You could've at least told me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You could've at least told me.”
entries.menuText: “You could've at least told me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How dare you show up here after wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you show up here after what we agreed!"
entries.menuText: "How dare you show up here after what we agreed!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Explain yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: “Explain yourself."
entries.menuText: “Explain yourself."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know, but...I just thought you w..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know, but...I just thought you would say no again.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You were damn right. I would say n..."
entries.dialogueText: “You were damn right. I would say no, and I am saying no."
entries.menuText: “You were damn right. I would say no, and I am saying no."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't we have any trust in each ot..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't we have any trust in each other anymore?”
entries.menuText: “Don't we have any trust in each other anymore?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So you went behind my back to join..."
entries.dialogueText: “So you went behind my back to join this meeting?”
entries.menuText: “So you went behind my back to join this meeting?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You know how much I want to help w..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know how much I want to help women in Sordland. I had an opportunity and I couldn't let it pass.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You also know how stubborn I am. O..."
entries.dialogueText: “You also know how stubborn I am. Once I set my mind on something, I won't budge.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You have my trust always. But this..."
entries.dialogueText: “You have my trust always. But this is a greater cause than just the two of us. I wouldn't have done this if I didn't believe that."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“We finally have the chance to chan..."
entries.dialogueText: “We finally have the chance to change things for Sordish women. There's no way I was going to let that opportunity pass."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Anton, please try to understand. I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anton, please try to understand. I wouldn't do this if I didn't think this was necessary.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“We're at a place where we can fina..."
entries.dialogueText: “We're at a place where we can finally change the status of Sordish women. I couldn't let this opportunity pass.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“So when Ciara asked me to join her..."
entries.dialogueText: “So when Ciara asked me to join her today, I had to accept."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ciara needs to learn that she can'..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ciara needs to learn that she can't interfere with my family.”
entries.menuText: “Ciara needs to learn that she can't interfere with my family.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This doesn't change the fact that..."
entries.dialogueText: “This doesn't change the fact that you didn't trust me.”
entries.menuText: “This doesn't change the fact that you didn't trust me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“To be honest, I would've done the..."
entries.dialogueText: “To be honest, I would've done the same if that was what it took to get my word across.”
entries.menuText: “To be honest, I would've done the same if that is what it took to get my word across.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know. And I'm sorry. Will you......"
entries.dialogueText: “I know. And I'm sorry. Will you...will you forgive me?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Don't blame her. She just did what..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't blame her. She just did what was necessary for the future of Sordish women.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I knew you would understand.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I knew you would understand.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No.”
entries.menuText: “No.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If you promise never to surprise m..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you promise never to surprise me like this again."
entries.menuText: “If you promise never to surprise me like this again."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I promise.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I promise.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes were shining."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes were shining.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes. I forgive you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. I forgive you.”
entries.menuText: “Yes. I forgive you.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Thank you, Anton. I will tell you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Anton. I will tell you everything from now on.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Please, Anton. Let me stay.""
entries.dialogueText: “Please, Anton. Let me stay."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“All right. Let's discuss this toge..."
entries.dialogueText: “All right. Let's discuss this together.”
entries.menuText: “All right. Let's discuss this together.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My answer is still no. You will no..."
entries.dialogueText: “My answer is still no. You will not go into politics.”
entries.menuText: “My answer is still no. You will not go into politics.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“But why? This is about Sordish wom..."
entries.dialogueText: “But why? This is about Sordish women. This is bigger than just politics.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's simply too dangerous. I don't..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's simply too dangerous. I don't want you to get hurt.”
entries.menuText: “It's simply too dangerous. I don't want you to get hurt.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't be naive. Everything comes d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't be naive. Everything comes down to politics in the end.”
entries.menuText: “Don't be naive. Everything comes down to politics in the end.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I understand the danger, but someo..."
entries.dialogueText: “I understand the danger, but someone has to do it.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Right.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hugged me and kissed me on the..."
entries.dialogueText: She hugged me and kissed me on the cheek.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No canoodling at work, Mrs. First..."
entries.dialogueText: “No canoodling at work, Mrs. First Lady.”
entries.menuText: “No canoodling at work, Mrs. First Lady.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“All right. Can you call Ciara back..."
entries.dialogueText: “All right. Can you call Ciara back?”
entries.menuText: “All right. Can you call Ciara back?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I'll fetch Ciara so we can get sta..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll fetch Ciara so we can get started."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Of course. I'll go get her.""
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. I'll go get her."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica left the office and returned..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica left the office and returned with Ciara. Both women were smiling.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know I don't understand politics..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know I don't understand politics the way you and Ciara do. But my role would be that of a spokeswoman. That's all.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You know how much I want to help w..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know how much I want to help women in Sordland. I had an opportunity, and I couldn't let it pass."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Ciara approached me about it. I ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ciara approached me about it. I had to accept."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Without asking my permission!?""
entries.dialogueText: “Without asking my permission!?"
entries.menuText: “Without asking my permission!?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why didn't you tell her I forbade..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why didn't you tell her I forbade it?"
entries.menuText: "Why didn't you tell her I forbade it?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Do you think she'd take that for a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do you think she'd take that for an answer?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Look, I'm sorry for yelling. But w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Look, I'm sorry for yelling. But we talked about this before and I clearly said it would be a bad idea."
entries.menuText: “Look, I'm sorry for yelling. But we talked about this before and I clearly said it would be a bad idea."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know it was a surprise to you. I..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know it was a surprise to you. I'm sorry. I will tell you everything from now on.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Can you forgive me?""
entries.dialogueText: “Can you forgive me?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Why should a wife need her husband..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why should a wife need her husband's permission to do something?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What are you going to do? Leave me..."
entries.dialogueText: “What are you going to do? Leave me? You wouldn't dare."
entries.menuText: “What are you going to do? Leave me? You wouldn't dare."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Just watch me.""
entries.dialogueText: “Just watch me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She walked to the door and wrenched..."
entries.dialogueText: She walked to the door and wrenched it open. She walked away and closed the door with a loud slam.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please don't say that. I'm sorry.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please don't say that. I'm sorry.”
entries.menuText: “Please don't say that. I'm sorry.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“There are things at play here that..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are things at play here that are greater than just us.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Look. I will be blunt. If you want..."
entries.dialogueText: “Look. I will be blunt. If you want to remain happily married, you will let me do this. I need this. Sordish women need this.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I want to be their voice.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I want to be their voice.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can't you let Ciara do that? She i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can't you let Ciara do that? She is more experienced.”
entries.menuText: “Can't you let Ciara do that? She is more experienced.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You don't know how hard it is to b..."
entries.dialogueText: “You don't know how hard it is to be in that position. I'm trying to protect you.”
entries.menuText: “You don't know how hard it is to be in that position. I'm trying to protect you.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I understand that. At least I thin..."
entries.dialogueText: “I understand that. At least I think I do. But I really need to do this. For my own dignity as a Sordish woman and to root out the evil inside people like Curtan Leste.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Ciara has the experience, but peop..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ciara has the experience, but people think she's a radical, and un-feminine at that. She's not popular enough with the public to get this message across. I am.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm sorry, but I can't let you do..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sorry, but I can't let you do that. Please understand.”
entries.menuText: “I'm sorry, but I can't let you do that. Please understand.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“This is my line in the sand, Anton..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is my line in the sand, Anton. Now that I'm here, I won't back down."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well. If it's that important..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. If it's that important to you, stay."
entries.menuText: “Very well. If it's that important to you, stay."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Then I hope you will understand th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Then I hope you will understand this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could say anything, she go..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could say anything, she got up and left my office.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Thank you, Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I'll go fetch Ciara so we can get..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll go fetch Ciara so we can get started.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica briefly left the office and..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica briefly left the office and returned with Ciara. The two women were smiling.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Jump to: [Ciara Womens Rights Monica Feedback]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked down at the floor, th..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked down at the floor, then back up at me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Do you trust me?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Do you trust me?”
entries.menuText: “Do you trust me?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Yes, of course I do.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, of course I do.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Then believe me when I say: don't..."
entries.dialogueText: “Then believe me when I say: don't get involved in politics."
entries.menuText: “Then believe me when I say: don't get involved in politics."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well. I will allow it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I will allow it.”
entries.menuText: “Very well. I will allow it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stood there for a few minutes as..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood there for a few minutes as I contemplated what had just happened. Eventually, Ciara knocked and entered my office again.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Jump to: [Ciara Womens Rights Monica Feedback]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stood in silence for a few minute..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood in silence for a few minutes, contemplating what had just happened, Eventually, Ciara knocked and entered my office again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica left the office. A short tim..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica left the office. A short time later, Ciara knocked on the door.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Jump to: [Ciara Womens Rights Monica Feedback]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are getting close to the electi..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are getting close to the elections. I can't handle any possible bad press.”
entries.menuText: “We are getting close to the elections. I can't handle any possible bad press.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know Benfi may have crossed a li..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know Benfi may have crossed a line, but this is different.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is my final answer. You will..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is my final answer. You will not do it.”
entries.menuText: “This is my final answer. You will not do it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“All right. If you are willing to t..."
entries.dialogueText: “All right. If you are willing to take the risk, I will let you do it.”
entries.menuText: “All right. If you are willing to take the risk, I will let you do it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I leaned forward."
entries.dialogueText: I leaned forward.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica's eyes narrowed."
entries.dialogueText: Monica's eyes narrowed.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""All right.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I was born ready.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I was born ready.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She made her way to the door."
entries.dialogueText: She made her way to the door.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Anton, before we start...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Anton, before we start...”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I just wanted to thank you for agr..."
entries.dialogueText: “I just wanted to thank you for agreeing to this meeting."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I've been dreaming about this ever..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've been dreaming about this ever since I volunteered with the Sordish League of Women. I can't believe the moment's finally here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Anything to make you happy.""
entries.dialogueText: “Anything to make you happy."
entries.menuText: “Anything to make you happy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I think both of you together could..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think both of you together could finally bring change to Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “I think both of you together could finally bring change to Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I hope you're right.""
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you're right."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Not just me, Anton. All of us.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not just me, Anton. All of us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope you thought this through. R..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you thought this through. Real change requires carefully considered plans.”
entries.menuText: “I hope you thought this through. Real change requires carefully considered plans.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“We did.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We did.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a couple of knocks at the doo..."
entries.dialogueText: After a couple of knocks at the door, Ciara entered the room with folders in her hand.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Jump to: [Ciara Womens Rights Monica Feedback]

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Not a particularly auspicious star..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not a particularly auspicious start to this meeting. But let's begin."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“And this isn't only a moral issue...."
entries.dialogueText: “And this isn't only a moral issue. I have seen enough revolutions in this world to understand the main driver of any change.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara sat down on a chair and laid..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara sat down on a chair and laid down the folder she was holding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She flipped a folder open and start..."
entries.dialogueText: She flipped a folder open and started pulling out documents.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“In United Contana, law dictates th..."
entries.dialogueText: “In United Contana, law dictates that women earn the same wages as men in their respective fields. My research shows that this led to a 15.5% increase in productivity. You could say this had a direct influence on their superpower status.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Arcasia passed laws ensuring mater..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arcasia passed laws ensuring maternity leave rights, child day care centers and tax deductions for working families. In turn, they experienced a 12.6% productivity boost and a flourishing economy."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Both countries also have significa..."
entries.dialogueText: “Both countries also have significantly lower infant mortality rates, a statistic I believe is directly linked to the improved status of women.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Our administration has successfull..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our administration has successfully managed to pull Sordland back from the brink of economic ruin."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Our administration has thus far fa..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our administration has thus far failed to pull Sordland out of its economic recession."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“So I am asking: Why stop there? Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: “So I am asking: Why stop there? Why not improve our economy and modernize our society at the same time?"

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“So I am asking: Why not try passin..."
entries.dialogueText: “So I am asking: Why not try passing similar laws? At worst, even if they fail to improve the economy, it'll still be a significant step forward for our society."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned back in her chair."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned back in her chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned back in her chair."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned back in her chair.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“It's only logical.""
entries.dialogueText: “It's only logical."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It feels too much like you're comp..."
entries.dialogueText: “It feels too much like you're comparing Sordland to other nations. We must choose our own path.”
entries.menuText: “It feels too much like you're comparing Sordland to other nations. We must choose our own path.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You've made a good case for all of..."
entries.dialogueText: “You've made a good case for all of these changes.”
entries.menuText: “You've made a good case for all of these changes.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“I want to establish a commission f..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to establish a commission for women's rights in Sordland with me as its head. Our goal shall be passing and implementing a set of laws to solve the problems we just discussed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara handed me one of the document..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara handed me one of the documents. It had a list of bullet points on it.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Or even as their counterparts in A..."
entries.dialogueText: “Or even as their counterparts in Arcasia and United Contana. We've been lagging behind on this for decades, Anton."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“What are your thoughts so far?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What are your thoughts so far?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm not sure I can risk passing la..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not sure I can risk passing laws like these so close to the election.”
entries.menuText: “I'm not sure I can risk passing laws like these so close to the election.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“These laws would result in greater..."
entries.dialogueText: “These laws would result in greater productivity, a better economy *and* happier women -- to be frank, Mr. President, you'd have to be a fool not to pass them."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“If we can pull this off before the..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we can pull this off before the elections, the Rayne administration will make history.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“I agree completely. We must aim to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree completely. We must aim to be better than them. Better than all the superpowers.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“None of them have yet managed to a..."
entries.dialogueText: “None of them have yet managed to achieve true parity among the sexes. If we can do that, we'll make history.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Let's talk about how to proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: “Let's talk about how to proceed."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Or even as their counterparts in A..."
entries.dialogueText: “Or even as their counterparts in Arcasia and United Contana. We've been lagging behind on this for decades."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica handed me one of the documen..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica handed me one of the documents. It had a list of bullet points on it.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“As the commission's spokeswoman, m..."
entries.dialogueText: “As the commission's spokeswoman, my responsibility will be to make speeches and organize fundraisers. I will be the face of this movement while Ciara handles the groundwork."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“If I can show that the First Lady..."
entries.dialogueText: “If I can show that the First Lady is behind this movement, many women will feel encouraged.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara gestured down at her outfit."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara gestured down at her outfit.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“The organization's name will be 'C..."
entries.dialogueText: “The organization's name will be 'Commission on the Status of Women'.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why bother with a commission? I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why bother with a commission? I can pass the laws you want here and now."
entries.menuText: “Why bother with a commission? I can pass the laws you want here and now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's going to be damn hard getting..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's going to be damn hard getting your laws past the Assembly."
entries.menuText: “It's going to be damn hard getting your laws past the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“You'll still need to make sure the..."
entries.dialogueText: “You'll still need to make sure they're effectively implemented.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Mr. President, I know we've had fr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President, I know we've had friction in the past -- whether over the failed education reform, or the teaching of creationism."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“This is a completely separate topi..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is a completely separate topic and it should be handled as such.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Mr. President, I know we've had fr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President, I know we've had friction in the past. But this has nothing to do with the failed education reform."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Mr. President, I know we've had fr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President, I know we've had friction in the past. But this has nothing to do with your decisions on creationism."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“One more thing to consider before..."
entries.dialogueText: “One more thing to consider before making your decision. This could help silence any of the public's lingering questions regarding your former vice president and the Livia Suno affair."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“One more thing to consider before..."
entries.dialogueText: “One more thing to consider before making your decision. This could help silence any of the public's lingering questions regarding your vice president and the Livia Suno affair."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“You have the chance to be a hero...."
entries.dialogueText: “You have the chance to be a hero. Think about your daughter and her future.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“I hope you will make the right dec..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you will make the right decision.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“And that man would want a better f..."
entries.dialogueText: “And that man would want a better future for his daughter and her daughters. No matter what else he's said or done."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I hope you'll make the right decis..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you'll make the right decision. We both do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They rose from their seats expectan..."
entries.dialogueText: They rose from their seats expectantly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara rose from her seat expectantl..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara rose from her seat expectantly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a few minutes to think."
entries.dialogueText: I took a few minutes to think.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm on your side. But I want to go..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm on your side. But I want to go through the Assembly. Can't risk a backlash this close to the election.”
entries.menuText: “I'm on your side. But I want to go through the Assembly. Can't risk a backlash this close to the election.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well. I hereby decree your la..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I hereby decree your laws passed and your commission established. Good luck.”
entries.menuText: “I hereby declare your laws passed and your commission established. Good luck." [Sign Decree. -2 Government Budget]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will approve the creation of the..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will approve the creation of the commission and support your bill in the Assembly.”
entries.menuText: “I will approve the creation of the commission and support your bill in the Assembly.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Great. Amazing. You won't regret t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Great. Amazing. You won't regret this, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Then all is lost for the future of..."
entries.dialogueText: “Then all is lost for the future of women in Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Your female constituents will reme..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your female constituents will remember you as a failure.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“And so will I.”"
entries.dialogueText: “And so will I.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Monica. She was silen..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Monica. She was silent for a moment.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“How do I explain this to Deana, on..."
entries.dialogueText: “How do I explain this to Deana, once she's old enough to understand? How do I tell her about all the opportunities she could have had, that her own father denied her?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without waiting for my answer, she..."
entries.dialogueText: Without waiting for my answer, she pushed her chair aside and stormed out. Ciara followed suit, and I could hear the two of them talking angrily as the door closed behind them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara furiously gathered up her doc..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara furiously gathered up her documents.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sagged back in my chair and exhal..."
entries.dialogueText: I sagged back in my chair and exhaled. It was a clear day outside, but the perfect view over Holsord provided little comfort.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Money.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Money.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I know. That's why I already signe..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know. That's why I already signed the decree to give women an equal education."
entries.menuText: “I know. That's why I already signed the decree to give women an equal education."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Yes, and that was a major step for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, and that was a major step forward. But there's so much more work that must be done."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What are you doing here?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you doing here?"
entries.menuText: "What are you doing here?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ciara, what is she doing here?""
entries.dialogueText: "Ciara, what is she doing here?"
entries.menuText: "Ciara, what is she doing here?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. No! Monica, go home!""
entries.dialogueText: "No. No! Monica, go home!"
entries.menuText: "No. No! Monica, go home!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“See, that's why this meeting is so..."
entries.dialogueText: “See, that's why this meeting is so necessary!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Someone has to stay home and look..."
entries.dialogueText: “Someone has to stay home and look after Deana.”
entries.menuText: “Someone has to stay home and look after Deana.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I'm doing this *for* Deana. And fo..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm doing this *for* Deana. And for so many other girls like her.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This isn't about joining a knittin..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about joining a knitting circle or having a friend for tea. It's about my career!"
entries.menuText: "This isn't about joining a knitting circle or having a friend for tea. It's about my career!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I promise I take women's rights se..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise I take women's rights seriously. Just let Ciara handle this."
entries.menuText: "I promise I take women's rights seriously. Just let Ciara handle this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Because you'll make me look foolis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because you'll make me look foolish otherwise -- like you did at the Benfi Festival."
entries.menuText: "Because you'll make me look foolish otherwise -- like you did at the Benfi Festival."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Your career. For which you have co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your career. For which you have consistently sidelined me and your children."
entries.menuText: "Your career. For which you have consistently sidelined me and your children."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I had dreams of a career too, back..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had dreams of a career too, back in university. But I gave those up for you."
entries.menuText: "I had dreams of a career too, back in university. But I gave those up for you."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm starting to think it wasn't wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm starting to think it wasn't worth it."
entries.menuText: "I'm starting to think it wasn't worth it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I gave you a life most woman can o..."
entries.dialogueText: “I gave you a life most woman can only dream of, and this is how you thank me?”
entries.menuText: “I gave you a life most woman can only dream of, and this is how you thank me?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'll fetch Ciara so you two can ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll fetch Ciara so you two can get on with your business."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I did ask her to come to the meeti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did ask her to come to the meeting, as I thought her media traction after the Benfi Festival would make her a valuable spokeswoman. But she told me she was, and I quote, 'barred from politics'."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shot me a sharp, meaningful loo..."
entries.dialogueText: She shot me a sharp, meaningful look.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's for her own good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's for her own good.”
entries.menuText: “It's for her own good.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is between Monica and myself...."
entries.dialogueText: “This is between Monica and myself. Stay out of it.”
entries.menuText: “This is between Monica and myself. Stay out of it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Monica would only be a liability t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Monica would only be a liability to your cause.”
entries.menuText: "Monica would only be a liability to your cause.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Be thankful I'm not firing you for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be thankful I'm not firing you for approaching her behind my back.”
entries.menuText: "Be thankful I'm not firing you for approaching her behind my back.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""First off, Mr. President, I wish t..."
entries.dialogueText: "First off, Mr. President, I wish to thank you for pushing a decree on establishing gender equality in education. You know this is something I've been trying to accomplish since my appointment as minister. The situation in the public schools was disturbing for me."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""With that said, we still have a lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that said, we still have a long way to go before Sordish women are able to enjoy the same rights and privileges as men."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""These are the measures I believe a..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are the measures I believe are most urgently needed."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""The two of us talked it over, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The two of us talked it over, and these are the measures we believe are most urgently needed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I let my eyes wander down the list."
entries.dialogueText: I let my eyes wander down the list.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Criminalizing domestic violence.""
entries.dialogueText: "Criminalizing domestic violence."
entries.menuText: "Criminalizing domestic violence."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Support for working mothers.""
entries.dialogueText: "Support for working mothers."
entries.menuText: "Support for working mothers."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Equal treatment in the workforce.""
entries.dialogueText: "Equal treatment in the workforce."
entries.menuText: "Equal treatment in the workforce."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gender equality in public educatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gender equality in public education."
entries.menuText: "Gender equality in public education."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I shouldn't have to tell you how c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shouldn't have to tell you how crucial this is. It is utterly unbelievable that, in this day and age, Sordish men are legally allowed to beat their wives."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara looked at me closely, as if s..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara looked at me closely, as if she were scrutinizing my reaction. How much had Monica told her?

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. It's a travesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. It's a travesty."
entries.menuText: "I agree. It's a travesty."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What families do in their own home..."
entries.dialogueText: "What families do in their own homes is none of our concern."
entries.menuText: "What families do in their own homes is none of our concern."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm happy we're on the same page.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy we're on the same page."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I'm happy we're on the same page.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy we're on the same page."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica and Ciara both looked disgus..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica and Ciara both looked disgusted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara looked disgusted."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara looked disgusted.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""With all due respect, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Mr. President, it is. By staying lenient on this we are essentially telling Sordish women that the state doesn't care about them."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""As incidences are especially high..."
entries.dialogueText: "As incidences are especially high within Bludish communities, I would also advocate for setting up a special domestic violence task force in collaboration with Bludish women's rights organizations."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Are you sure that's something we o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure that's something we ought to focus on? The Bluds are... different. They have their own rules."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked at her strangely."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked at her strangely.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Monica, I'm surprised at you! We c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Monica, I'm surprised at you! We can't let women suffer under the patriarchy, no matter their ethnicity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Interfering in Bludish matters has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interfering in Bludish matters has landed us in enough trouble already."
entries.menuText: "Interfering in Bludish matters has landed us in enough trouble already."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Bluds have their own ways of s..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bluds have their own ways of settling these issues."
entries.menuText: "The Bluds have their own ways of settling these issues."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should lift up all Sordish wome..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should lift up all Sordish women, Bluds included."
entries.menuText: "We should lift up all Sordish women, Bluds included."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Bluds must conform to Sordish..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bluds must conform to Sordish law."
entries.menuText: "The Bluds must conform to Sordish law."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm still not sure criminalizing d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm still not sure criminalizing domestic violence is a good idea. For the Bluds or anyone else."
entries.menuText: "I'm still not sure criminalizing domestic violence is a good idea. For the Bluds or anyone else."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We can discuss the particulars onc..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can discuss the particulars once the law has passed."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I assure you it is. But I'll give..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you it is. But I'll give you some time to think about it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara nodded.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""It simply isn't fair that women in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It simply isn't fair that women in the workforce are punished for having children."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Remember what I told you about Jan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember what I told you about Janice? My friend who basically got fired for becoming pregnant? That would never happen to a man."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Paid maternity leave and state-sub..."
entries.dialogueText: "Paid maternity leave and state-subsidized daycare centers could be key to keeping more mothers employed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't want to reward women for c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to reward women for choosing work over raising their children."
entries.menuText: "I don't want to reward women for choosing work over raising their children."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's true -- having children never..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true -- having children never hindered my career prospects. It shouldn't hinder a woman either."
entries.menuText: "It's true -- having children never hindered my career prospects. It shouldn't hinder a woman either."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll have to think about this.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll have to think about this."
entries.menuText: "I'll have to think about this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Monica, you always said you never..."
entries.dialogueText: "Monica, you always said you never regretted giving up a career to raise Franc and Deana."
entries.menuText: "Monica, you always said you never regretted giving up a career to raise Franc and Deana."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton, I never had a choice.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, I never had a choice."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Please do. Moving on.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please do. Moving on."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""What about women who have to work..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about women who have to work to provide for their children? This could lead to healthier families and a healthier economy."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Moving on.""
entries.dialogueText: "Moving on."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I'm happy you agree. In theory, at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy you agree. In theory, at least."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That's an easy one.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's an easy one."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Right now, Sordland has one of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right now, Sordland has one of the continent's largest pay gaps between men and women. We need legislation ensuring that a woman doing the same job as a man is paid the same wage."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""We would also introduce quotas to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would also introduce quotas to get more women into positions of power -- in the Assembly, for instance, or on the boards of corporations."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Eventually. Narrowing the pay gap..."
entries.dialogueText: "Eventually. Narrowing the pay gap is a far more pressing issue, as it would bring financial independence to countless lower-income women."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Ciara, we never talked about this...."
entries.dialogueText: "Ciara, we never talked about this. But I always thought that with more women in power, higher status for all women would naturally follow."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Women are starving because they do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Women are starving because they don't make a living wage. That's a damn sight more important than your friend Janice being passed over for a promotion."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""A quota for women in positions of..."
entries.dialogueText: "A quota for women in positions of power -- on the boards of large corporations, for instance, or even within the Assembly -- would also be advisable."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Quotas are a terrible idea. People..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quotas are a terrible idea. People should be hired on merit, not simply because of their sex."
entries.menuText: "Quotas are a terrible idea. People should be hired on merit, not simply because of their sex."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't see a problem with quotas,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see a problem with quotas, but tackling the pay gap is much more urgent."
entries.menuText: "I don't see a problem with quotas, but tackling the pay gap is much more urgent."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Quotas seem far easier to implemen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quotas seem far easier to implement than equal pay laws. We should start there."
entries.menuText: "Quotas seem far easier to implement than equal pay laws. We should start there."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara gritted her teeth."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara gritted her teeth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gritted her teeth."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gritted her teeth.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""My thoughts exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "My thoughts exactly."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Thank you, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We'll see about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll see about that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica and Ciara looked at me stran..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica and Ciara looked at me strangely.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Men are hired on the basis of thei..."
entries.dialogueText: "Men are hired on the basis of their sex all the time. Just not consciously."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara looked at me strangely."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara looked at me strangely.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Men are hired on the basis of thei..."
entries.dialogueText: "Men are hired on the basis of their sex all the time. Just not consciously."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""There are more than enough qualifi..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are more than enough qualified women to fill any position you can think of. It's up to us to give them the opportunity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara grinned."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara grinned.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""You know how much this means to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how much this means to me. And you've witnessed the dangers firsthand."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""The way girls are shut out of a re..."
entries.dialogueText: "The way girls are shut out of a real education unless their parents have the means to get them out of the public school system -- so many bright minds are being lost."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I wouldn't entirely demean the old..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't entirely demean the old system, Ciara. Deana still loves her handicrafts classes."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I'm not saying we'll take those aw..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not saying we'll take those away. Maybe boys should learn handicrafts too."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica burst out laughing."
entries.dialogueText: Monica burst out laughing.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Imagine Franc in an apron!""
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine Franc in an apron!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't force schools what to tea..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't force schools what to teach to whom."
entries.menuText: "We can't force schools what to teach to whom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, we've had this conversation...."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we've had this conversation. I'm entirely on your side."
entries.menuText: "Yes, we've had this conversation. I'm entirely on your side."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But Deana loves her handicrafts cl..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Deana loves her handicrafts classes."
entries.menuText: "But Deana loves her handicrafts classes."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I'm not saying we'll take those aw..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not saying we'll take those away. Maybe boys should learn handicrafts too."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We've had this conversation, Ciara..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've had this conversation, Ciara. I'm entirely on your side."
entries.menuText: "We've had this conversation, Ciara. I'm entirely on your side."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My voters won't want to see their..."
entries.dialogueText: "My voters won't want to see their sons in an apron."
entries.menuText: "My voters won't want to see their sons in an apron."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You've got a point.""
entries.dialogueText: "You've got a point."
entries.menuText: "You've got a point."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We can if not doing so puts us on..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can if not doing so puts us on the wrong side of history. Have you forgotten what we decided about evolution?"

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We can if not doing so puts us on..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can if not doing so puts us on the wrong side of history. I still believe you made a mistake with your creationism decision."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Good. Then we see eye to eye on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Then we see eye to eye on the matter."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""But maybe they'll want to see thei..."
entries.dialogueText: "But maybe they'll want to see their daughters become the next Artvin Einstavn."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Let's move on for now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's move on for now."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""That covers all subjects.""
entries.dialogueText: "That covers all subjects."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Jump to: [Listened to Issues - Next Steps]

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Especially those who aren't keen o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially those who aren't keen on pantsuits."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""And convince the public the change..."
entries.dialogueText: "And convince the public the changes will be beneficial."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's going to be damn hard getting..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's going to be damn hard getting your laws past the Assembly."
entries.menuText: “It's going to be damn hard getting your laws past the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What do you need a commission for?..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you need a commission for? I'll run your laws past the Assembly."
entries.menuText: "What do you need a commission for? I'll run your laws past the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara leaned toward me."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara leaned toward me.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Nia would kill me for saying this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nia would kill me for saying this, but... this is one case where using your decree powers would be fully justified."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What exactly is going on between y..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly is going on between you and Mrs. Morgna, anyway?"
entries.menuText: "What exactly is going on between you and Mrs. Morgna, anyway?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shrugged uncomfortably."
entries.dialogueText: She shrugged uncomfortably.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We're friends. That's all.""
entries.dialogueText: "We're friends. That's all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll be the judge of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be the judge of that."
entries.menuText: "I'll be the judge of that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Look who's suddenly off her moral..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look who's suddenly off her moral high horse."
entries.menuText: "Look who's suddenly off her moral high horse."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're right. The Assembly would o..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. The Assembly would only pass a weak version of these laws, if at all."
entries.menuText: "You're right. The Assembly would only pass a weak version of these laws, if at all."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I know. But even a watered-down ve..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. But even a watered-down version would be better than nothing."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""If it's for the greater good, I ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's for the greater good, I have no problem bypassing the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""Even if that's successful, you'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if that's successful, you'll still need the commission to ensure the laws are successfully implemented."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""And convince the public the change..."
entries.dialogueText: "And convince the public the changes will be beneficial."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've already given women equal acc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already given women equal access to education. I want to see how that decision shakes out before making any new laws."
entries.menuText: "I've already given women equal access to education. I want to see how that decision shakes out before making any new laws."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry, but the answer is no. You c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, but the answer is no. You can try and run your laws by the Assembly, but they'll get no support from me."
entries.menuText: "Sorry, but the answer is no. You can try and run your laws by the Assembly, but they'll get no support from me."

entries.speaker: Monica
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica turned to her."
entries.dialogueText: Monica turned to her.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That's all the excitement you can..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's all the excitement you can muster? You did it! We did it!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica hugged Ciara. She smiled unc..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica hugged Ciara. She smiled uncomfortably.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""You're making a mistake by not pus..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're making a mistake by not pushing this through right away. But I'm happy for your support."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We still have a long way to go. I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have a long way to go. I'll start gathering names for the commission tonight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara started collecting her docume..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara started collecting her documents.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Monica headed towards the d..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Monica headed towards the door. Monica paused before leaving.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I love you, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love you, Anton."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Whatever our differences, I'm glad..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever our differences, I'm glad you were able to set them aside and act for the good of Sordish women."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'll see you at home.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you at home."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She headed towards the door, then p..."
entries.dialogueText: She headed towards the door, then paused and turned back to me.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I wish your wife could be here rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish your wife could be here right now to celebrate your decision. We both know how much this means to her."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me one last time befo..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me one last time before walking out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could hear Monica and Ciara talki..."
entries.dialogueText: I could hear Monica and Ciara talking excitedly to each other as the door closed behind them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara folded her arms."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara folded her arms.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We've waited long enough, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've waited long enough, Mr. President. If you aren't re-elected, this opportunity will be lost."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I suggest you think long and hard..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suggest you think long and hard about how you're going to explain yourself to your wife. We both know how much this means to her."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me one last time befo..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me one last time before leaving the office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a long sip from the bottle o..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a long sip from the bottle of whiskey in my office desk drawer, then picked up the phone and called Monica.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked out my window over the cit..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked out my window over the city of Holsord. It was a clear day outside.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""We still have a long way to go bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have a long way to go before Sordish women are able to enjoy the same rights and privileges as men."

entries.speaker: Monica
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara let out a lengthy exhale. Her..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara let out a lengthy exhale. Her face had started to turn red from holding her breath for so long.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As she made eye contact with me, he..."
entries.dialogueText: As she made eye contact with me, her professional side took hold. She swiftly straightened her posture and put on the icy mask of an experienced politician.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""It's not over yet, Monica. The tru..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not over yet, Monica. The true battle is in the Assembly. We'll celebrate once that's over with."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I'll start gathering names for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll start gathering names for the commission tonight."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I hope this is still as important..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this is still as important to you as it used to be. And I trust you to do the right thing."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You never did listen to me about t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never did listen to me about the importance of woman's rights. Maybe you'll take your own minister more seriously."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica lowered her voice."
entries.dialogueText: Monica lowered her voice.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton, I think you'll agree that I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, I think you'll agree that I've put up with quite a lot over the course of your presidency."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""And that man would want a better f..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that man would want a better future for his daughter and her daughters. Just like you told me you did all those years ago."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""But despite it all, I look at you..."
entries.dialogueText: "But despite it all, I look at you and I still see the idealistic, driven man I married."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica lowered her voice."
entries.dialogueText: Monica lowered her voice.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton, I think you'll agree that I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, I think you'll agree that I've put up with quite a lot over the course of our marriage."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""But some part of me still sees you..."
entries.dialogueText: "But some part of me still sees you as the idealistic, driven man I married."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica lowered her voice."
entries.dialogueText: Monica lowered her voice.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton, I'm not completely naive. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, I'm not completely naive. I know what we're proposing would have its downsides."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""But every time I look at our daugh..."
entries.dialogueText: "But every time I look at our daughter, I think about how I'd do anything to grant her a better future."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know you would too. Even if you..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know you would too. Even if you might not admit it."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I know you would too. Just like yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you would too. Just like you told me all those years ago."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara was looking studiously at a s..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara was looking studiously at a scratch on my desk. She blinked and turned back to us.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“That's right, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That's right, Mr. President.”
